title: Happy Fisherman Holding Catch on Boat, 1964 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckle-edged snapshot photo showing a smiling man aboard a motorboat holding a tall fishing rod in one hand and his caught fish in the other. He is dressed casually for a windy day on the water in a hooded pullover sweatshirt with the hood pulled up and denim jeans. The boat helm, steering wheel, and cabin partition are visible behind him. The right border is stamped '• AUG • 64', capturing a classic mid-century American recreational summer outing.
